raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The NPU MMLU accuracy cases cannot fetch their dataset on the CI runners. `sgl_eval` downloads the `cais/mmlu` archive with its own `httpx` client: it ignores `HF_ENDPOINT`, prints nothing while downloading and never retries, so a blocked or slow mirror is indistinguishable from a hang. The community runners can only reach Hugging Face through the mirror (direct `huggingface.co` returned `503` for several days in October), so the archive has to be staged before the test starts.

## Modifications

- `_npu-pr-test-stage.yml`: prefetch `data.tar` with `hf download cais/mmlu --include data.tar --local-dir` (goes through `HF_ENDPOINT`, has progress and retries), falling back to `curl` against the mirror, then export `SGLANG_EVAL_ARCHIVE_DIR`. `HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1` is set so the prefetch uses the classic HTTP path instead of the Xet CAS server that the mirror does not proxy. A failed prefetch only emits a warning, so the job degrades to the previous behaviour.
- `npu_eval_accuracy_kit.py`: add `honor_local_sgl_eval_archive()`. It matches a prefetched archive by URL basename, re-checks the digest with sgl_eval's own `_loader._file_sha256` (a stale or truncated copy falls back to the original download instead of grading other data), and runs the vendored `prepare.save_data()` with `URL` pointed at that local file. The prefetched archive lives outside the prepare work directory, so `urlretrieve()` cannot truncate the source it is reading. The shim is applied on import, so every NPU accuracy case benefits without per-test changes, and it declines to install when the installed sgl_eval does not expose either helper.
- `test_mmlu.py`: call the shim explicitly, so `TestMMLU` does not depend on some other case importing the kit first.

## Accuracy Tests

- `test_npu_sampling_backend.test_mmlu` (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, 64 questions, threshold 0.65), run through `nightly-1-npu-a3` on an A3 2-card runner:
  - the prefetched archive is picked up from `SGLANG_EVAL_ARCHIVE_DIR` (`/tmp/sgl_eval_archives/data.tar`, 159 MB);
  - `[METRIC] mmlu_score=0.796875`, `stop_rate=1.0`, `invalid=0.0`, `latency=32.3s`;
  - no `httpx` download and no `503` in the log, i.e. the dataset load is fully local.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

 import math
 import os

 import requests
 
@@ -32,6 +33,64 @@ class TestFoo(CustomTestCase, NPUGSM8KMixin):
     "nightly-test-npu.yml" not in os.environ.get("GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF", "")
 )
 
+# sgl_eval downloads benchmarks (MMLU data.tar included) with its own httpx
+# client: it ignores HF_ENDPOINT, prints nothing and never retries, so a blocked
+# mirror looks like a hang. CI prefetches the archive instead; the shim below
+# re-checks the pinned digest and feeds prepare the local file.
+_SGL_EVAL_ARCHIVE_DIR_ENV = "SGLANG_EVAL_ARCHIVE_DIR"
+_SGL_EVAL_ARCHIVE_DIR_DEFAULT = Path.home() / ".cache" / "sgl_eval" / "archives"
+
+
+def honor_local_sgl_eval_archive():
+    """Point sgl_eval's archive-backed prepare at a prefetched local copy."""
+    archive_dir = Path(
+        os.environ.get(_SGL_EVAL_ARCHIVE_DIR_ENV) or _SGL_EVAL_ARCHIVE_DIR_DEFAULT
+    )
+    if not archive_dir.is_dir():
+        return
+    try:
+        from sgl_eval.evals import _loader
+    except ImportError:
+        return
+    original = getattr(_loader, "_save_data_from_verified_archive", None)
+    file_sha256 = getattr(_loader, "_file_sha256", None)
+    if (
+        original is None
+        or file_sha256 is None
+        or getattr(original, "_sglang_local_archive_shim", False)
+    ):
+        return
+
+    def _save_data_from_verified_archive(
+        mod, save_args, save_kwargs, archive_url, archive_sha256, work_dir
+    ):
+        local = archive_dir / archive_url.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
+        expected = (archive_sha256 or "").lower()
+        if not (
+            expected
+            and hasattr(mod, "URL")
+            and local.is_file()
+            and file_sha256(local) == expected
+        ):
+            return original(
+                mod, save_args, save_kwargs, archive_url, archive_sha256, work_dir
+            )
+        # save_data() writes <work_dir>/<archive name>; the prefetched copy
+        # lives elsewhere, so urlretrieve() cannot truncate its own source.
+        original_url = mod.URL
+        try:
+            mod.URL = local.as_uri()
+            mod.save_data(*save_args, **save_kwargs)
+        finally:
+            mod.URL = original_url
+
+    _save_data_from_verified_archive._sglang_local_archive_shim = True
+    _loader._save_data_from_verified_archive = _save_data_from_verified_archive
+
+
+# Applied on import, so no per-case wiring is needed; a no-op without the dir.
+honor_local_sgl_eval_archive()
+
 
 def run_npu_pr_smoke(base_url):
     """Send a single inference request for PR pipeline smoke test."""
